# 1 Chronicles Chapter 21 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 381r–381v

---

**21:1** And-stood Satan [satan] against Yisra'el, and-incited [vayyaset] David to-number [limnot] Yisra'el.

**21:2** And-said David to Yo'av and-to the-princes of-the-people: Go, count [sifru] Yisra'el from-Be'er-Sheva and-to Dan, and-bring to-me, and-I-will-know their-number [mispar].

**21:3** And-said Yo'av: May-YHWH add to-his-people like-them a-hundred times [me'ah pe'amim]. Are-they-not, my-lord the-king, all-of-them servants [avadim] to-my-lord? Why does-my-lord seek [mevaqesh] this? Why should-it-be a-guilt [ashmah] for-Yisra'el?

**21:4** And-the-word of-the-king prevailed [vayechezaq] over Yo'av, and-went-out Yo'av and-walked-about in-all Yisra'el and-came to-Yerushalayim.

**21:5** And-gave Yo'av the-number [mispar] of-the-counting [mifqad] of-the-people to David. And-was all Yisra'el a-thousand thousand [elef elef] and-a-hundred thousand [me'ah elef], men drawing [sholef] sword [cherev]. And-Yehudah [was] four-hundred and-seventy thousand, men drawing sword.

**21:6** And-Levi and-Binyamin he-did-not count [lo faqad] among-them, for the-word of-the-king was-abhorrent [nit'avah] to-Yo'av.

**21:7** And-it-was-evil in-the-eyes of-Elohim concerning this thing, and-he-struck Yisra'el.

**21:8** And-said David to-Elohim: I-have-sinned [chatati] greatly that I-did this thing. And-now, please take-away [ha'aver na] the-iniquity [avon] of-your-servant, for I-have-been-very-foolish [niskhalti me'od].

**21:9** And-spoke YHWH to Gad, the-seer [chozeh] of-David, saying:

**21:10** Go and-speak to David, saying: Thus says YHWH: Three [things] I am-extending [noteh] over-you; choose for-yourself one of-them, and-I-will-do-[it] to-you.

**21:11** And-came Gad to David and-said to-him: Thus says YHWH: Accept [qabbel] for-yourself:

**21:12** either three years of-famine [ra'av], or three months being-swept-away [nispe] before your-foes [tsareyikha] and-the-sword of-your-enemies [oyeveyikha] overtaking [le-masseget], or three days the-sword of-YHWH — and-pestilence [dever] in-the-land, and-the-angel [mal'akh] of-YHWH destroying [mashchit] in-all the-territory [gevul] of-Yisra'el. And-now see what word I-shall-return [to] the-one-who-sent-me.

**21:13** And-said David to Gad: [I am] in-great-distress [tsar li me'od]. Let-me-fall [nippelah] now in-the-hand of-YHWH, for his-mercies [rachamav] are-very-great [rabbim me'od]; and-in-the-hand of-man let-me-not fall.

**21:14** And-gave [vayyitten] YHWH a-pestilence [dever] in-Yisra'el, and-fell from-Yisra'el seventy thousand men [shiv'im elef ish].

**21:15** And-sent the-Elohim an-angel [mal'akh] to-Yerushalayim to-destroy-it [le-hashchitah], and-as-he-was-destroying, YHWH saw and-relented [vayyinnachem] concerning the-evil [ha-ra'ah], and-said to-the-destroying [ha-mashchit] angel: Enough [rav]! Now stay [heref] your-hand. And-the-angel of-YHWH was standing [omed] by the-threshing-floor [goren] of-Ornan the-Yevusi.

**21:16** And-lifted David his-eyes and-saw the-angel of-YHWH standing between the-earth and-between the-heavens [ha-shamayim], and-his-sword [charbo] drawn [shelufah] in-his-hand, stretched-out [netuyah] over Yerushalayim. And-fell David and-the-elders [ha-zeqenim], covered [mekussim] in-sackcloth [saqqim], upon their-faces.

**21:17** And-said David to-Elohim: Was-it-not I who-said to-number the-people? And-I — I am the-one-who sinned [chatati], and-I-certainly-did-evil [vehare'a hare'oti]. And-these, the-flock [ha-tson], what have-they-done? YHWH my-Elohim, let-your-hand be against-me and-against the-house of-my-father, and-not against-your-people for-a-plague [lim'gephah].

**21:18** And-the-angel of-YHWH said to Gad to-say to-David, that David should-go-up to-raise [lehakim] an-altar [mizbe'ach] to-YHWH on the-threshing-floor of-Ornan the-Yevusi.

**21:19** And-went-up David according-to the-word of-Gad that he-spoke in-the-name of-YHWH.

**21:20** And-turned-back [vayyashov] Ornan and-saw the-angel, and-his-four sons with-him were-hiding-themselves [mitchabbe'im]. And-Ornan was threshing [dash] wheat [chittim].

**21:21** And-came David unto Ornan, and-looked Ornan and-saw David, and-went-out from the-threshing-floor and-bowed-down [vayyishtachu] to-David, face [appayim] to-the-ground [artsah].

**21:22** And-said David to Ornan: Give [tenah] to-me the-place [maqom] of-the-threshing-floor, and-I-will-build on-it an-altar to-YHWH. For-the-price of-full-silver [keseph male] give-it to-me, and-the-plague [ha-maggephah] shall-be-restrained [te'atser] from-upon the-people.

**21:23** And-said Ornan to David: Take [qach] for-yourself, and-let-my-lord the-king do the-good [ha-tov] in-his-eyes. See, I-give the-oxen [ha-baqar] for-burnt-offerings [la'olot] and-the-threshing-sledges [ha-morigim] for-wood [la'etsim] and-the-wheat for-the-grain-offering [la-minchah] — the-whole [ha-kol] I-give.

**21:24** And-said the-king David to Ornan: No, for buying [qanoh] I-will-buy [eqneh] for-full-silver [be-kheseph male], for I-will-not take what-[is]-yours for-YHWH, and-offer-up [veha'alot] a-burnt-offering [olah] without-cost [chinnam].

**21:25** And-gave David to-Ornan for-the-place gold [zahav] shekels [shiqley], weight [mishqal], six hundred.

**21:26** And-built David there an-altar to-YHWH, and-offered-up burnt-offerings and-peace-offerings [shelamim], and-called to-YHWH. And-he-answered-him [vayyaanehu] with-fire [ba-esh] from the-heavens [ha-shamayim] on the-altar of-the-burnt-offering [mizbach ha-olah].

**21:27** And-said YHWH to-the-angel, and-he-returned his-sword to-its-sheath [nidanah].

**21:28** At-that time, when-David-saw that YHWH had-answered-him at-the-threshing-floor of-Ornan the-Yevusi, he-sacrificed there.

**21:29** And-the-tabernacle of-YHWH [mishkan YHWH] that Mosheh made in-the-wilderness [ba-midbar] and-the-altar of-the-burnt-offering [were] at-that time in-the-high-place [bamah] at-Giv'on.

**21:30** And-was-not-able David to-go before-it to-inquire of-Elohim, for he-was-terrified [niv'at] from-the-face of-the-sword of-the-angel of-YHWH.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "Satan" vs. "YHWH":** The single most discussed variant between Chronicles and Samuel. In 2 Samuel 24:1, "the anger of YHWH burned against Israel, and he incited David." In 1 Chronicles 21:1, "Satan stood against Israel and incited David." The Chronicler replaces YHWH with *satan* (adversary) — reflecting a post-exilic theological development in which God no longer directly causes evil. Whether *satan* here is a proper name (Satan) or a common noun (an adversary/accuser) is debated. The absence of the definite article (*ha-satan*, as in Job 1-2) may suggest a proper name.

**v.5 — The numbers:** Chronicles has 1,100,000 for Israel and 470,000 for Judah. 2 Samuel 24:9 has 800,000 for Israel and 500,000 for Judah. The totals (1,570,000 vs. 1,300,000) differ significantly.

**v.12 — "three years":** 2 Samuel 24:13 reads "seven years" of famine. Chronicles reduces to three, creating a symmetrical triad: three years, three months, three days.

**v.15 — "YHWH saw and relented":** The Hebrew *vayyinnachem* — God "repented" or "relented" or "was grieved." This verb (nacham, niphal) is theologically significant: God changes course in response to destruction, not in response to David's repentance (which comes later, v.17).

**v.25 — "six hundred shekels of gold":** 2 Samuel 24:24 says "fifty shekels of silver." The Chronicler escalates the price dramatically — gold instead of silver, six hundred instead of fifty. This reflects the site's future significance: this threshing floor will become the temple site. The price must match the dignity of the location.

**v.26 — Fire from heaven:** Unique to Chronicles. God answers David's sacrifice with fire from heaven — a sign of divine acceptance that echoes Elijah on Carmel (1 Kings 18:38) and will recur at Solomon's temple dedication (2 Chr 7:1). The Chronicler adds this detail to confirm that this site is divinely chosen for the temple.

*— EMET*
